items.text: Morgan Stanley reported voluntary attrition in 2025 of 9% globally, a figure covering all employees rather than financial advisors specifically.

cells.reason: The firm's CEO disclosed an adviser retention rate above 99% (a fact on advisor retention, the inverse of turnover); the 9% voluntary attrition figure is also included but covers all employees globally rather than financial advisors.
